svg.title: Freelingo node — jump here, locked
svg.desc: Original work for Freelingo (AGPL-3.0). Flat plate with the measured 3D lip (deep/08 §2): the lip disc sits 16 units below the face disc, which is the 4 px lip at the 64 px node size. This is the state before a jump-here test is offered on the node; S019's `failed` returns to `offered`, because failure is non-punitive and retryable. Product map: S019.
